title: Q&A with Dr. Dre and Jimmy Iovine on lessons from Apple's Beats acquisition, creativity, being pro-AI music creation, AI as a tool like drum machines, and more (Jordyn Holman/New York Times)
summary: Jordyn Holman / New York Times: Q&A with Dr. Dre and Jimmy Iovine on lessons from Apple's Beats acquisition, creativity, being pro-AI music creation, AI as a tool like drum machines, and more — The hit-making duo turned tech moguls also have thoughts about why corporate America isn't collaborative enough.
